description: Sri lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange effective from 01.05.2017 to 07.05.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter. The content focuses on statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations.
